A throttle decrease is a step, not a ramp: shared/outputs/include/outputs.h:54-57 ('going up is ramped and coming down is immediate') and shared/outputs/outputs.c:353-363 (a throttle coming down is applied on the pass the command arrives). The only rate limit, SET_OUT_RAMP 5 to 300 %/s (shared/settings/settings.c:61-63), applies upward, and the motor current against throttle is not stated. The T4 figure of 741 µs rested on that upward ramp, a linear current law and default pack settings, and was refuted and adjudicated (T4/015-adjudicator-R9.json). requirements.name: input rating

requirements.required: own input apart from the 2S pack's lead

requirements.name: isolation
requirements.required: isoSPI or digital-isolator barrier, 85 V DC working or more
requirements.datasheet: ISOMD to VREG sets pins 53, 54, 61 and 62 for 2-wire isoSPI, transformer or capacitor coupled (Figures 79 and 106); ISOMD to V- gives 4-wire SPI referenced to V-, for a digital isolator. requirements.name: tap current
